subject: Extension of Term of Mr. Harsh Gupta, Junior Administrative Officer (SG), till Superannuation
content: INDRAPRASTHA INSTITUTE OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY DELHI (IIIT- Delhi) Dr. Deepika Bhaskar Registrar Ref. No.: IIITD/HR/PF-HarshG/209/2020/2875 Date: 24th January 2025 Office Order No. 217/2025 Term Review of Mr. Harsh Gupta As per the recommendations of the Review Committee, in the meeting held on 16th January 2025, the term of Mr. Harsh Gupta, Junior Administrative Officer (SG) has been extended till superannuation, in continuation of his tenure at the Institute. The other terms of service will remain the same as mentioned in the offer letter and contract, as applicable from time to time. This issues with the approval of the Competent Authority.
